test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All doors are walls.

All walls are rooms.

All rooms are flats.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some flats are doors.

II. All walls are flats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56573386f2243148fec22a83ce2fb07862dbf213759d6efbb0cdbfa50410f981.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flats are doors. → Follows (As, All doors are walls, All walls are rooms and All rooms are flats)

II. All walls are flats. → Follows (As, All walls are rooms and All rooms are flats)

Hence, '**Both conclusions I and II follow**' is the correct answer.
